Term1: Chlamydial or non-gonococcal urethritis, cervicitis or proctitis
Text:
# CHLAMYDIAL OR NON-GONOCOCCAL URETHRITIS, CERVICITIS OR PROCTITIS

*Local guidance (Omaha CDSS, Inpatient):*
CHLAMYDIAL OR NON-GONOCOCCAL URETHRITIS OR CERVICITIS
Treatment for chlamydial or non-gonococcal urethritis or cervicitis

References:

- St. Cyr S, et al. MMWR Morb Mortal Wkly Rep 2020, 69:1911-1916.
- Sanford keyword: Chlamydia trachomatis
- Lau, A., et al. N Engl J Med 2021, 384: 2418-2427
- Up-To-Date article: Chlamydia trachomatis
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Preferred option (especially for rectal chlamydia or in non-pregnant individuals):

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 days ($) [DI]

### < OR >
Azithromycin 1 gm PO ONCE ($) [M]
Treatment for chlamydial or non-gonococcal cervicitis in pregnant women

Azithromycin 1 gm PO ONCE ($) [M]

*Local guidance (Omaha CDSS, Inpatient):*
Mandell chapter: Urethritis
Mandell chapter: Vulvovaginitis and Cervicitis
Sanford keyword: Urethritis, cervicitis: chlamydial
Up-To-Date article: Acute cervicitis
Up-To-Date article: Urethritis in men

## Outpatient

Preferred option (especially for rectal chlamydia or in non-pregnant individuals):

Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID for 7 days ($) [DI]

### Preferred for pregnant individuals:

Azithromycin 1 gm PO x 1 dose ($) [M]
